function.arguments: {"observation": "The treatment arm has a higher proportion of severe patients (95) compared to control (21), and severe patients have lower response rates. This indicates that the raw difference is confounded by severity — a classic case of Simpson's paradox.", "implication": "The raw difference in proportions (treatment - control) is not a valid estimate of the treatment effect because the groups are not comparable.
